description: Makes a print-ready PDF permit report for a Texas address or coordinate and project type: who governs the spot, holds in force, every permit by level (federal, state, utility, county, city) with why it applies, status, review time, fee, form and the verbatim source quote with its URL, the sequenced timeline with the critical path, and what each county or city does not publish. Same inputs as permit_plan. Returns a link valid 30 minutes. Enterprise.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

building_sf.description: Building floor area in square feet.

disturbed_acres.description: Acres of soil disturbed during construction.

height_ft.description: Tallest structure or crane height in feet above ground.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

oil_storage_gal.description: Aboveground oil storage capacity in gallons (fuel tanks, transformer oil).

onsite_gen_mw.description: On-site generation that runs beyond emergency use (MW). 0 if none.

wastewater.description: Where process water / cooling blowdown goes.

name: permit_report
title: Permit report (PDF)
